單字數量：請依照下方英文原題的輸入、輸出規格完成程式。

C++ 沒有 Python 切片語法；請使用索引、迴圈、substr()、find()、rfind()、erase() 或 replace()。
description.en:
Given a string consisting of words separated by spaces. Determine how many words it has. To solve the problem, use the method count.

C++ note: C++ has no Python slice syntax. Use indexes, loops, substr(), find(), rfind(), erase(), or replace().
